activity_summary: You kept her price and not the rest of the act. A pin, for a play that begins in a broken oath. The washing is the better note. The ladies have no sentence. You stopped.

facets.activity: Kept her price of a pin and stopped

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A pin. She would not give a pin for a play that begins in a broken oath.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The washing is the better note. The ladies have no sentence.
